init.title: Custom screens
init.description: Templates for up to 4 custom screens. Each one with text joins the display rotation after the regular screens and updates whenever its template changes. Leave a field empty to remove that screen. Example: `{example}`. Long text scrolls. Needs firmware with custom screen support.
